issue.title: Prompt migration writes legacy prompts into the agents sidecar without publication scanning and advises a raw re-push after GH013

task_type_fields.impact:
`sase agent prompts migrate --write` is an operator-run, one-time historical migration. Its source prompts are already public in the plans sidecar, so the risk is not new exposure there. The command can, however, copy secret-bearing text into the public agents sidecar without the local scan, and the published operator guidance would replay a rejected secret commit.

Fix direction:
- Scan migrated prompt text through the shared publication-protection adapter, withholding hits the same way the regular prompt publishers do.
- On a secret-scan rejection of the agents push, route through `publication_recovery.recover_publication_push`, or at least stop advising a raw re-push.

Found by the sase-1oh.5.1 land agent while auditing every agents-sidecar writer. This gap predates that epic; its rejection-recovery phase only sanitized the migration push diagnostic.
task_type_fields.repro:
1. Read `src/sase/agents_sync/prompt_archive/migration.py`. `_plan_items` and `_apply_month` copy legacy plans-store prompt files into the agents sidecar's `prompts/` tree and commit them through `_commit_paths`. Nothing on this path calls the publication-protection scanner (`sase.agents_sync.prompt_archive.protection` / `publication_protection`). By contrast, the regular direct, deferred, and full-sync prompt publishers scan every document before staging.
2. `_publish_migration_sidecars` pushes with `git push origin HEAD`. On failure, `_sanitized_migration_push_detail` sanitizes GH013 and repository-rule output. `_publication_recovery_message` still tells the operator to re-run `git -C <agents clone> push origin HEAD`, which would resend the commit the remote just rejected for containing a secret. The rejection records no protection-ledger block, preserves nothing privately, and does not reset the managed clone.

issue.creation_reason: While auditing every agents-sidecar writer for epic sase-1oh.5.1, the lander found that sase agent prompts migrate bypasses the publication-protection scanner and its recovery message would replay a secret-rejected commit. This gap predates that epic.

payload.description: Prompt-publication phase whose shared protection adapter the migration writer should reuse
Need the original task bead scope, evidence, and acceptance for prompt-migration-protection

payload.entry: Fixed by epic sase-1pu phase sase-1pu.1, commit 81fdd689fb (code now lives in src/sase/agents_sync/prompt_archive/migration/ after the 207ded297a package split, with scanning and replay_push=False intact). The migration scans rewritten prompt text and the month index through scan_archive_text_bytes before staging; withheld files stay in the plans sidecar. Agents GH013/repo-rule rejections go through recover_publication_push, and the recovery message no longer suggests git push origin HEAD. The sase-1pu lander reran tests/agents_sync/test_prompt_archive_migration.py on master 71827cfecc, including the clean, secret-withheld, and GH013 no-re-push tests: all passed (part of 91/91 focused tests).
